program.name: Floor Pull
program.subject: Bodyweight
program.blurb: Bodyweight strength with a pull every day, and no bar: floor pulls between push-ups and legs.
program.about: Bodyweight strength with a pull on every day and no bar needed. The pulls are done lying face down: prone lat pulls, superman rows, reverse snow angels and supermans, or table rows if you have a sturdy table. One day pairs them with push-ups, the other with single-leg work, in straight sets with full rests. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
